In cslib#839, I define language homomorphism and prove that regular languages are closed through preimage under language homomorphisms. The corresponding result for the image operation will await future work.

@Fabrizio Montesi The construction LTS.mapLabel is now defined as a special case of LTS.mapHom. So I have renamed the file LTS/mapLabel.lean to LTS/mapHom.lean, but I have kept your theorems (though with different proofs that specialize the more general results about LTS.mapHom).
Very nice, in the queue it goes. :)
